FN-8JMX2F2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 113 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alcoholic Beverage Control
Board until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
